setupSteps.title: Install Git
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Git responds with a version number

setupSteps.title: Install Node LTS
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Node responds with a version number

steps.title: Check Git and Node
steps.body: Use Terminal. Any current Node LTS works.
steps.verifierLabel: Git and Node respond with version numbers

steps.title: Copy OpenASCII to this Mac
steps.command:
cd ~
if [ ! -d OpenASCII/.git ]; then
git clone https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/OpenASCII.git
fi

steps.title: Open the OpenASCII folder
steps.verifierLabel: Your terminal prompt is inside the OpenASCII folder

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.verifierLabel: The install finishes without an error

steps.title: Start OpenASCII
steps.body: Keep Terminal open — OpenASCII runs from it, and closing the window stops it.
steps.verifierLabel: The terminal prints a localhost address

steps.title: Open OpenASCII
steps.body: If the terminal printed a different address, open that one instead.
steps.verifierLabel: The OpenASCII studio loads in your browser

steps.title: Drop in a photo
steps.body: Drag any JPG, PNG or GIF onto the canvas. Nothing is ever uploaded.
steps.verifierLabel: Your photo is redrawn as ASCII art

expect.prompt: Is the ASCII picture on the canvas an image the reader just dropped in, rather than OpenASCII's built-in demo — a round face with two eyes and a smile, above the word OPENASCII on a dark band?

hints: If the browser opened the image on its own, drop it on the picture itself, not on an empty part of the page.
Or click the REPLACE IMAGE box at the top of the sidebar and choose a file.
